description: Jake Morrison requests and attends a one-on-one meeting with Rick Tanner. He brings 90-day close data, a pipeline breakdown by price tier, and a personal read on buyer hesitation patterns from floor experience. He asks Rick directly about the stay bonus: the qualifying period and whether floor sales staff are eligible. He presents himself not as someone asking for protection but as someone with transferable buyer-behavior insight who wants to be useful in the post-assessment dealership structure.
information_shared: buyer objection patterns from direct floor experience
direct ask on stay bonus qualifying period and eligibility
expected_response: Rick provides a candid answer on the stay bonus details and signals how Jake is being categorized in the consolidation readiness assessment.
